name: av_lim_blowup_inf
source:
{ Finite-time blow-up: y' = y^2 from y(0) = 1 escapes at time = 1. Both engines
  must report the step-size underflow at the same t, not emit Infinity rows. }
DYNAMIC blowup (method = ode45, time = 0 .. 3, points = 7)
  der(Yv) = Yv*Yv
  Yv(0) = 1
END

error.message: DYNAMIC: step size underflow near t = 1.0000000672479283 — the system may be too stiff for method 'ode45' (try ode23s or ode15s).
